findings.note: ESPN has Byfield at 2 goals and 2 assists in 11 games, with points in only two of them. He ended a seven-game point drought on 10/29, was scoreless vs BUF on 10/31 in 22:15 of ice time, and has lately played on the second line while Laferriere handles top-line duties.

Byfield left the Oct. 20 game with an upper-body injury after 2:44, missed two games, and returned Oct. 26 centering the second line with Moore and Ward. No newer injury update turned up, and the search did not confirm tonight's lineup.

In the Oct. 3 game against tonight's opponent, the Sharks, Byfield had a power-play goal on four shots plus an assist. RotoWire expects him to get significant power-play time, which works against the Under.
